name: Record detail page
summary: Breadcrumb back to the list, header with status badge and actions, tabbed sections of facts in cards, and a confirmation dialog before delete.
description: The page for one record (a project, user, order, booking). It answers "what is this and what can I do with it": identity and status in the header, the record's actions next to the title, details grouped into tabs, and destructive actions guarded by AlertDialog.
whenToUse: Users open one record from a list to see everything about it and act on it.
whenNotToUse: Quick edits of a few fields: use form-dialog from the list page.
Records with one field group: skip Tabs and show the cards directly.

children.role: title = record name; badges = status; actions = Edit (secondary) + Delete (destructive)
Facts as a <dl>, 2 columns from sm
destructive confirmation; names the record and the consequence

layout: Facts are a description list (dl/dt/dd), not a table and not loose paragraphs.
Record actions live in PageHeader actions: secondary for edit, destructive for delete; at most one cta.
Tabs only when there are two or more sections; the first tab is the overview.
responsive: PageHeader wraps actions under the title on narrow screens.
Overview grid stacks below lg; facts go from 1 to 2 columns at sm.
accessibility: Breadcrumb's current item is BreadcrumbPage (aria-current) and not a link.
CardTitle renders h3; under the PageHeader h1 pass aria-level={2}.
AlertDialog title names the record ("Delete \"Website redesign\"?") and the description states what is lost; the confirm label repeats the verb.
states: Loading: page-states skeleton in the content area, keeping breadcrumb and title placeholders. Not found: ErrorState variant=empty with a link back to the list.
antiPatterns: A generic "Are you sure?" that does not name the record.
